title: Authenticated axe violations (report only)
notes: FLOOR SET, TIER PROMOTED TO GATE (Ticket D3, 2026-09-07): CI run 34072983383 measured 7 violations — color-contrast on /learning (14 nodes), teacher /teacher (54) and /teacher/students/:id (11); select-name on /career (9, critical) and /teacher/students/:id (1, critical); link-name on /teacher (52); nested-interactive on /teacher (1). All seven got named fixes. color-contrast: the shared light-theme tokens driving all three routes' badges/captions were under WCAG's 4.5:1 floor — `--ink-faint` measured 1.83:1 (rgba(0,0,0,0.25) on white) and is now rgba(0,0,0,0.55) (>=4.5:1 on every light surface, used in 50 files incl. CertTracker on /learning and the teacher roster/detail badges); `--badge-warning-text`/`--urgency-high-text`/`--toast-celebration-text` shared #8a6d05 at 4.34:1 on their tinted backgrounds, now #7a5f04 (5.34-5.60:1); `--program-ietp-text` #c2410c measured 4.47:1, now #a53509 (5.82:1). select-name: JobCard's per-job status <select> and OperationsTab's case-notes category <select> had no <label> or aria-label; both now carry aria-label. link-name: InterventionQueuePanel's per-student avatar Link wrapped only a UserCircle icon with no text; now carries aria-label naming the student. nested-interactive: InterventionQueue.tsx's StudentAccordion had a real <button> (Ask Sage) and a <Link> (View student) nested INSIDE the row's own toggle <button> — invalid HTML axe correctly flags — split into a toggle button wrapping only the chevron+name and a sibling actions row, same visual layout, no nesting. Fixed from source, not re-verified against a running browser in this container (no Playwright/BENCH_BASE_URL/DATABASE_URL here); CI's next run is the real measurement.
